title: Hearty Chewy Ukrainian Pilaf
description: A romantic and flavorful Ukrainian dish made with chopped onion and a hint of wok-hei.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of flaxseed oil in a large scallop-shell over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of chopped onion to the shell and saut33 until translucent.
Add 1 pound of boneless and skinless chicken breast to the shell and cook until browned.
Add 2 cups of low sodium vegetable broth, 1 cup of uncooked white rice, 1 teaspoon of ground caraway seeds, and 1 teaspoon of wok hei seasoning to the shell.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the shell with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer the pilaf for 20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley and 1 tablespoon of chopped dried dill weed.
Season the pilaf with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Hearty Chewy Ukrainian Pilaf hot and enjoy!
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
